title: Full-Stack Web Developer
description:
### **Job Description**


We are looking for a Full\-Stack Web Developer with strong knowledge of WordPress and modern web technologies. The ideal candidate should be capable of developing premium, modern, responsive websites and web applications and should continuously keep up with the latest technologies and development trends.


* Advanced WordPress development – custom themes, plugins, Gutenberg, Elementor and WooCommerce.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL and REST APIs.
* Knowledge of modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js and TypeScript.
* Experience with AWS, Google Cloud/Azure, VPS, Linux, DNS, SSL, hosting and deployments.
* Knowledge of Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Docker and modern development practices.
* Ability to develop and integrate APIs, payment gateways, third\-party tools and web applications.
* Strong understanding of website security, performance optimization, Core Web Vitals and mobile responsiveness.
* Good knowledge of technical SEO, including schema, sitemap, robots.txt, redirects, indexing and Search Console.
* Good understanding of UI/UX and ability to create clean, premium and conversion\-focused websites.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools, AI/LLM APIs and automation is an advantage.
* Ability to research, learn and implement new and emerging web technologies.
* Troubleshoot, maintain, upgrade and optimize existing websites and applications.

#### **Candidate Profile**


We are looking for someone who is technically strong, creative, curious and eager to learn, with the ability to recommend the right technology for each project rather than being limited to traditional WordPress development.


A strong portfolio of websites/web applications is preferred.


**Location:** Kochi


**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Office\-Based


**Experience:** 2\+ Years


**Salary:** Rs 25K \+


**Status:** Open

description:

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Senior Full Stack Engineer** 

**Experience Level: 8 – 12 Years** 

**Location: Kochi, India**

**Primary Domain: Backend, Microservices \& Cloud Secondary Focus: Frontend Integration (Full Stack)**

**Ownership \& Ownership Mindset Requirement**

We are seeking a proactive technical professional who acts as a true owner of their deliverables. In this role, you will hold end\-to\-end accountability for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining high\-performance microservices. You are expected to take complete responsibility for architectural clarity, code quality, automated testing, system resilience, and cloud operations.

**Role Overview** 

As an Associate Full Stack Engineer (Backend/Cloud Focus), you will serve as a core technical driver for project's backend engine while remaining cross\-functional across the entire stack. You will architect robust RESTful APIs, manage cloud services, optimize streaming data workflows, and ensure seamless delivery from development through production.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Core Backend Development:** Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and production\-ready microservices using Java 17\+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Hibernate/JPA.

· **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/ Azure cloud services. Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure workflows.

· **Data Management \& Persistence:** Optimize database interactions across relational databases (PostgreSQL/ Oracle) and NoSQL stores. Implement effective caching strategies (Redis) and asynchronous messaging queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

· **Cross\-Functional Full\-Stack Integration:** Collaborate closely with frontend teams to define clean API contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and integrate frontend components (Angular/TypeScript) whenever end\-to\-end feature delivery requires cross\-functional hands\-on contribution.

· **System Reliability \& Ownership:** Take full accountability for monitoring, bug resolution, operational performance, unit/integration testing (JUnit, Mockito), and code quality reviews.

**Required Technical Qualifications \& Experience**

· **Experience:** 8 to 12 years of hands\-on software development experience with a track record of owning backend systems.

· **Java \& Spring Ecosystem:** Deep proficiency in Java (Java 11/17\+), Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and RESTful API engineering.

· **Cloud \& DevOps:** Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure core infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI / Jenkins / GitHub Actions).

· **Databases \& Messaging:** Strong command of SQL, database optimization, ORM tools, and event\-driven architecture using Kafka or RabbitMQ.

· **Full Stack Aptitude:** Working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (Angular, TypeScript) and Web Sockets for real\-time user\-facing features.

**Core Competencies \& Mindset**

**Ownership \& Responsibility:** Demonstrates a "buck stops with me" attitude toward system stability, code reliability, and timely feature completion.

**Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex concurrency, performance bottlenecks, and distributed cloud issues.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Excellent communication skills to work seamlessly across architects, QA engineers, and frontend specialists.

Pay: ₹900,000\.00 \- ₹1,100,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have as a Full Stack Developer?
* This posting is based in Kochi\- Kerala, India. Are you ok with the commutation and/or relocation?
* Are you willing to accept the offered Salary range?

Work Location: In person

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1741325
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Application Engineering Senior Developer – .NET Full Stack \& Integrations**

  


**Application Engineer Lead**

  


**Job Summary:**



The Application Engineering Lead is responsible for designing, building, and owning complex full stack applications and enterprise integrations. This role requires deep technical expertise across .NET, API integrations, databases, and data pipelines, along with strong ownership of production systems, migration activities, and critical cutovers. The role operates with minimal supervision and serves as a key technical decision maker and escalation point.

  


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Application Development \& Integrations**


* Lead the design and implementation of **API integrations** using **REST, JSON**, and industry standard authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, API keys, etc.).
* Lead the design and Implementation of Front end applications using Angular/HTML/Typescript
* Build and maintain **robust, secure, and scalable integrations** with structured error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms.
* Design and implement **reverse and batch integrations** across internal and external systems.
* Act as the **technical authority** for complex integration patterns, data flows, and migration solutions.


**Database \& Data Engineering**


* Design and develop **SQL Server solutions**, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Perform **production data fixes** with strong governance, validation, and audit controls.
* Implement and manage **ETL and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or SSIS**.
* Handle **large scale, high volume data processing**, ensuring data accuracy, reconciliation, and integrity across systems.


**Production Ownership \& Reliability**


* Own **end to end accountability** for critical production systems and integrations.
* Lead **production issue triage, root cause analysis, and remediation,** maintaining composure and sound judgment during high severity incidents.
* Serve as a **trusted escalation point** during production issues, migration waves, and release cutovers.
* Ensure system stability, observability, and operational readiness across environments.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**


* Operate independently with **minimal guidance**, making informed technical and delivery decisions.
* Act as a **subject matter expert (SME)** for integration and migration initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with **business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams** to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Coordinate across multiple teams during migrations and production cutovers, ensuring aligned execution and clear communication.
* Mentor and guide engineers on integration patterns, coding standards, and operational best practices.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


**Frontend \& UI Engineering (Angular)**


* **Strong hands on experience with Angular (version 20\+) for enterprise grade web applications.**
* **Expertise in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).**
* **Experience designing and implementing component based architectures, reusable modules, and shared UI libraries.**
* **Strong understanding of Angular lifecycle hooks, dependency injection, routing, and state management.**
* **Experience with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables, subjects, and subscription management.**
* **Ability to consume and integrate REST APIs into Angular applications with proper error handling and retry logic.**
* **Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms on the UI (token handling, role based access, guards).**
* **Proficiency in frontend performance optimization, change detection strategies, and lazy loading.**
* **Familiarity with responsive design and enterprise UI standards.**
* **Experience troubleshooting and resolving production UI issues with minimal supervision.**


**Core Technology Stack**


* Strong hands on experience with **.NET / .NET Core,** C\#, and full stack application development.
* Extensive experience with **RESTful API design and integration**, including:
	+ JSON payloads and schema validation
	+ Authentication and authorization mechanisms
	+ Structured error handling and resiliency patterns

**Databases \& Data Processing**


* Advanced expertise in **SQL Server**, including:
	+ Complex query design
	+ Stored procedures and performance optimization
	+ Controlled production data fixes
* Strong understanding of **data reconciliation, validation, and high volume data handling.**


**ETL \& Integration Platforms**


* Hands on experience with **Azure Data Factory (ADF)** and/or **SSIS**.
* Knowledge of batch processing, scheduling, and dependency management.
* Experience designing **scalable data pipelines** for enterprise integrations.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**


* Direct reports
* Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
* Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team
* Liaison to the Business for that Portfolio / App

  


**Job Requirements:**


**Experience:**


* 6\+ years of experience in **application engineering / full stack development,** with significant exposure to enterprise integrations.
* Prior experience in **lead or senior technical roles** with ownership of production systems.
* Experience supporting **large migrations, platform transitions, or enterprise cutovers** is highly desirable.
